primary_estimate.label: Estimated listening time (legacy 3.5-minute average)
primary_estimate.note: Includes every archived scrobble, including tracks with unknown duration. An archive-wide estimate, not measured playback.

verified_duration_subset.note: Subset only: calculated from matched track durations. It is not actual playback measurement.

measured_spotify_playback.note: Measured progress intervals are reported separately and cover only periods captured by the local Spotify tracker.
